output:
To: lindqvist-family-blog
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Ok so I have news!! Meet Fernhollow Photo

Ok. Deep breath. I have news, and I wanted you all to hear it from me here and not across the mashed potatoes at Aunt Ruthie's.

I'm going out on my own. As of October 22 I am the owner of Fernhollow Photo LLC, which is a real actual business with a real actual website and real actual couples who have booked me. I'm a little bit freaking out and a lot excited, so bear with me, this one's long.

Here's how it happened. On October 6 Marisol told me she was closing Rosebud Lane at the end of the month. I shot for her for four years, and pretty much everything I know about photographing a wedding I learned from her. She let me follow her around until I knew what I was doing, and then she started handing me weddings to lead. When she told me about the studio she also told me I've been ready to do this for two years, and that she'd already sent six of her 2027 couples my way. So Marisol, if this ever gets back to you, thank you. I wouldn't be doing any of this without you.

The funny part is she's right about the two years. I know this probably looks like it came out of nowhere, but I've been planning it in my head for about that long. What I'd call it, what I'd charge, what kind of weddings I'd want. I just kept not doing it because I had a good job with someone I loved working for. And then the job ended and the plan was already sitting there.

So here's the plan, because I know some of you (hi Dad) are going to want the plan.

I have 14 weddings booked for 2027 already. Six of those are Marisol's referrals, and the other eight found me on their own, which I still can't quite believe. June is the busy one with four. The furthest out is at Wallowa Lake in September, and I'm already excited about that drive.

Health insurance is sorted. Dad, I'm going to say it again just for you. Health insurance is sorted. It's a marketplace plan, I picked it last week and it starts January 1. I know the school portrait idea came from a good place and I love you for it. But I've got the insurance, and I'm keeping the knees.

I'm also not doing the big ones alone. My friend Jae is second shooting the bigger weddings with me, and I pay him per wedding. The website went live November 1 and people are finding it.

Is it scary? Yes, a little. Not having somebody else's name on the paycheck is scary. But I'd rather be a little scared and doing this than comfortable and still wondering about it when I'm 40.

Ok, now the fun stuff.

The first booking that was 100% mine, with nobody referring me or vouching for me, is a couple named Dahlia and Ken. They're getting married June 12 at Timberline. They saw the pictures I took of a couple at Multnomah Falls, and that's what sold them. I read their email like six times, then made Sam read it out loud.

I filed the LLC paperwork on my lunch break, on my phone, in my car, in the parking lot of a Fred Meyer. Very glamorous. I hit submit and then sat there and cried a little next to the cart return. Don't tell anybody, I'm a professional.

Sam got me a cake to celebrate, and it was supposed to say FERNHOLLOW but it said FERNHOLOW, one L short. We ate it anyway and it was great, and I'm thinking of it as the first official typo of the business. Pickle got none of it and is still mad.

And now the part I really wanted to put in writing.

Grandma, the name is for you. Fernhollow is the fern hollow trail behind your old place in Gresham. That's where I took my first real pictures, with your Pentax, back when I had no idea what any of the dials did and you let me burn through film anyway. Every picture I've taken since started on that trail. I thought about a lot of names over those two years and that was the only one I ever really wanted. So it's yours, and I hope you like it.

Last thing. I'm bringing the camera to Thanksgiving, and I'd love to do free family pictures for anybody who wants them. Just your crew, or the kids, or you and the dog, whatever you want. Aunt Ruthie's yard has good light around 2 if it's not pouring, and if it is pouring we'll figure something out inside. Comment below if you want in so I know how much time to save. And yes, Uncle Greg, there will also be a group photo, so bring a coat this time.

Bree, I'm coming for Juniper pictures as soon as you're taking visitors. I'll wash my hands a lot.

Mom, yes, Sam's coming. We've got the rolls and the cranberry thing.

That's it, that's the news. I have my own business. Ask me anything you want at Thanksgiving, I'm happy to talk about it, I just wanted you to have the whole story first. Mostly I hope you'll be excited with me, because I'm really, really excited.

Love you all, see you on the 26th.

Tessa
